# Islamonlive.in

> The one and only comprehensive Islamic portal in Malayalam: news, opinion, columns, Shariah, Quran, culture and current affairs, published since 18 June 2012 from Kozhikode, Kerala, India, under D4 Media.

Google Search ignores this file (Search Central, 2026-06-29); it is published for other AI systems that read it. Crawling policy for everyone is in /robots.txt: search=yes, ai-train=no.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://islamonlive.in/): the latest Islamic news, opinion and columns in Malayalam
- [News](https://islamonlive.in/category/news/): current affairs
- [Opinion](https://islamonlive.in/category/opinion/): analysis and commentary
- [Shariah](https://islamonlive.in/category/shariah/): Islamic jurisprudence, Quran and Hadith studies
- [Culture](https://islamonlive.in/category/culture/): Islamic history, art and civilisation
- [Columns](https://islamonlive.in/category/columns/): regular columnists
- [Authors](https://islamonlive.in/authors-list/): every writer published on the portal
- [About](https://islamonlive.in/about/): the editorial team and the portal's history
- [Contact](https://islamonlive.in/contact/): editorial contact and article submissions

## Machine-readable resources

- [Sitemap index](https://islamonlive.in/sitemap_index.xml)
- [Google News sitemap](https://islamonlive.in/news-sitemap.xml): articles from the last 48 hours
- [RSS feed](https://islamonlive.in/feed/)

## Key facts

- Founded 18 June 2012 in Kozhikode, Kerala, India; published under D4 Media
- Language: Malayalam (ml)
- Editorial contact: editor@islamonlive.in
- Office: Hira Centre, Mavoor Road, Kozhikode, Kerala, India, 673004
